need.title: Election & Annual Meeting Information — proxy, voting certificate, paper ballot rules
need.body: Oct 13 TownSq from Megan Heins: Proxy is for quorum only (need 30% or 487 of 1,623 lots). Use pink Proxy Envelope or submit electronically on Get Quorum (email sent Oct 12; contact mheins@castlegroup.com if missing). Voting Certificate only if multi-owner, corporation, trust, LLC, or other entity. Paper ballot must include date, lot # (if known), address, print name, owner signature (only one name/signature required). Only one vote per household counted (first online or electronic). Secret election: ONLY the ballot in the small ballot envelope — if proxy or voting certificate is inside, vote will not count. Questions to mheins@castlegroup.com.
